secondary_pairs: All remaining four registered flow streams by two registered Spot return streams; never pick a winning pair or target from OOS results.
calendar: Every minute of TRAIN and OOS_SCREENING; preserve invalid future labels and report them. Do not use future validity as online eligibility. Validation is not inspected in this mechanism diagnostic.
training_direction: Sign of TRAIN Spearman correlation, determined once separately for every predeclared pair/variant/fold. Constant or insufficient train input gives unknown direction; do not flip using OOS.
train_cutoff: validation_start minus embargo minus max nominal label lag minus one microsecond; only TRAIN labels mature by this cutoff enter descriptive fit-period statistics.
test_maturity: Only labels mature by the predeclared exclusive test end enter descriptive outcome statistics. Tail minutes remain in the calendar as invalid or immature.
metrics: UTC daily versions of the same statistics
statistics: Official scipy.stats Pearson/Spearman implementation; their IID p-values are discarded. Correlations and signed response are descriptive only. No DSR/SPA/CSCV/PBO or dependence-aware confidence interval is claimed.
economic_fields: net CAGR, gross/net executed edge, strongest benchmark delta, break-even transaction cost and concentration of executed PnL are null: no strategy or executable-price ledger is constructed here.
budget: One deterministic run of all four fixed folds and all three fixed variants; no outcome-driven rerun. Each investigated pair is reported and counted as a descriptive hypothesis, not silently collapsed to a single trial.
